case_title: MYLADIMMAL SURENDRAN & ORS. v. STATE OF KERALA
aggravating_circumstances: Political rivalry, threat to life, multiple injuries, use of deadly weapons
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to death for murder
high_court_outcome: Conviction upheld, death sentence converted to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, a group of individuals, were involved in the murder of a BJP leader, who was killed in broad daylight in front of his wife. The deceased was attacked with weapons such as a billhook and an axe, resulting in fatal injuries. The wife, along with two other witnesses, provided consistent eyewitness accounts of the incident. The deceased's father also witnessed the attack. The victim was identified as having sustained multiple injuries consistent with the weapons used. A dying declaration from the victim corroborated the eyewitness accounts. The police investigation led to the arrest of the accused, who were subsequently tried and convicted. The High Court upheld the conviction but reduced the death sentence to life imprisonment. The Supreme Court dismissed the appeals and confirmed the High Court's decision.
